title: Rethinking Learning from Label Proportions via Moment Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.21262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning from label proportions (LLP) is a weakly supervised setting where training data are grouped into bags with only bag-level label proportions observed, and the goal is to learn a classifier that predicts labels for individual instances. Recently, a large body of methods has emerged; however, most of them rely on the assumption that instance-label pairs are sampled i.i.d. and randomly assembled into bags, an assumption often violated in real-world scenarios. Our experimental results indicate that these methods perform suboptimally under non-random settings. In this work, we adopt a more realistic assumption: bags are sampled i.i.d., and instance labels are conditionally independent given the instances. Under this setting, we show that the label counts follow a Poisson multinomial distribution. Motivated by this observation, we propose LLP via moment matching (LLP-MM), a simple yet effective approach which leverages multi-order fact

translated_title: 基于矩匹配重新思考标签比例学习
translated_abstract: 从标签比例中学习（Learning from Label Proportions, LLP）是一种弱监督学习设置，其中训练数据被分组为若干袋，仅能观察到袋级别的标签比例，目标是学习一个能够预测单个实例标签的分类器。近年来涌现了大量相关方法；然而，大多数方法依赖于“实例-标签对是独立同分布采样并随机组装成袋”这一假设，而该假设在现实场景中经常被违反。我们的实验结果表明，这些方法在非随机设置下表现欠佳。在这项工作中，我们采用了一个更符合现实的假设：袋是独立同分布采样的，且实例标签在给定实例的条件下相互独立。在这一设置下，我们证明了标签计数服从泊松多项式分布。受这一观察启发，我们提出了一种基于矩匹配的标签比例学习方法（LLP-MM），这是一种简单而有效的方法，它利用多阶因子…
tldr: 该论文提出了一种简单有效的基于矩匹配的标签比例学习方法（LLP-MM），在袋独立同分布采样这一更现实的假设下，利用标签计数服从泊松多项式分布并通过多阶矩匹配，显著改善了非随机分袋场景下的分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLP-MM, a simple yet effective moment-matching approach for learning from label proportions under a more realistic i.i.d. bag-sampling assumption, leveraging the fact that label counts follow a Poisson multinomial distribution to achieve superior performance in non-random bagging scenarios.
